conviction_note: The print is dominated by a pending take-private. On 2026-11-06 the controlling holder (Mangrove Coast, affiliated with chairman Justin Tang: ~94% of votes, ~48% of shares per the 13D) proposed $6.03/ADS, and a special committee was formed on 11-18. At spot $5.23 the stock sits 15.3% below the bid. That anchor should compress the earnings reaction well below this name's pre-proposal print moves of -15.7 and -26.2. Q3 fundamentals cut both ways: volume is still shrinking and there is no guide, while credit improved and provisions were released in Q2. The bar is unsourced, so every finding is capped small. impact_sum is +0.4 and the scaled number (p_up 51 x abs 4.5) is +0.09. Both say this is essentially a non-result. The upside tail is a definitive agreement or an update on the committee's process. The downside tail is a bidder-CEO talking the outlook down to defend a lowball price (about 0.2x book).

next_guide.basis: Guidance was dropped at Q2, and the CEO's affiliate is now the bidder, so management has every incentive not to issue an upbeat outlook ahead of a negotiated price. I expect no guide, or a cautious qualitative one.

findings.finding: The controlling holder proposed on 2026-11-06 to take XYF private at $6.03/ADS cash, a 28.3% premium to the prior close. The bidder holds ~94% of votes and ~48% of shares (13D: 110.9m shares, 47.97% of class, with Class B at 20 votes). A special committee of three independent directors was formed on 2026-11-18. Spot $5.23 is 15.3% below the bid, so the stock trades as a wide-spread arb. The only in-window paths to a big move are a deal update with the release (definitive agreement: low probability, ~5%, roughly +12%) or a hint the bid is being cut or withdrawn (~2%, roughly -10%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The proposal day itself moved +22.34% (11-06). The two later deal filings (AGM notice 11-16, special committee 11-19) moved -1.11% and -0.19% per baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The proposal itself is priced. What is not priced is whether the release carries a process update: the 15.3% spread, near-flat 5d tape and lack of arb compression show the market assigns real doubt or a long timeline. If an update were expected, the spread would be narrowing into the print, not widening from 4.9%.
findings.independence: The special committee 6-K, 2026-11-19 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1725033/000110465926129959/tm2630265d1_6k.htm), and BBT News on financing by bank debt plus rollover (https://www.bbtnews.com.cn/2026/1106/610644.shtml). Both describe the same proposal.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 loan volume is likely to shrink again from Q2's RMB11.63bn. Q2 was -20.5% QoQ and -70.2% YoY, and the company withdrew guidance. A 2026-09-27 industry piece says Chinese loan-facilitation platforms were broadly contracting under the new fee/APR rules, including a 2026 rule folding fees into an annualised cost (one of seven listed platforms growing). So revenue, near RMB994m in Q2, likely falls again QoQ. The shrink is the expected base case, with no guide to miss, and the deal anchor damps it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Volume/guide disappointments drove -15.7% (Q3'25) and -26.2% (Q4'25, weak Q1 guide) before the proposal. The Q2'26 volume at the low end of the guide got +2.04%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the deliberate shrink was flagged at Q2. If the market expected a re-acceleration, the stock would trade nearer the bid. Only the size of a further drop is open.
findings.independence: Industry proxy, partly garbled page: https://stock.stockstar.com/IG2026092700002284.shtml (2026-09-27). Search summaries also cite 'of 7 listed platforms only one growing' at the end of Q3. Proxy only, not company-confirmed.

findings.finding: Credit improved in Q2: 31-60 day delinquency fell to 1.73% from 2.61% in Q1, and 91-180 day to 9.09% from 9.95%. The loan-receivable provision fell to ~RMB10.1m from ~RMB52.3m in Q1, and net income rose 23.8% QoQ to RMB47.0m. If the release continues, Q3 profit can rise QoQ even on lower volume, and a richer profit print makes the $6.03 (~0.2x Q2 book equity of RMB7.76bn, ~$1.14bn) look safer or bumpable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's provision-driven profit uptick with the low-end volume print got +2.04%.
findings.why_not_priced: With no consensus and one stale analyst, nobody publishes a Q3 credit or profit estimate. The deal anchor means even a good number moves the spread only a little. If priced as a bump catalyst, the spread would be narrower than 15%.
findings.independence: Same document as the volume finding (Q2 release), so two readings of one document on different lines. The CEO called the delinquency improvement 'constructive' but said 91-180 remains elevated.

findings.finding: Since the 11-06 proposal the stock has slid from $5.75 to $5.23 (-9%), widening the spread to the $6.03 bid from 4.9% to 15.3%. That is not explained by any filing: the only later 6-Ks are the AGM notice (no proposals) and the special committee. The market prices material doubt or a long timeline. A routine release that confirms the process is under way, without signalling a price cut, can narrow that slightly.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print under a pending bid.
findings.why_not_priced: The spread is the price of the doubt, so this finding only says that doubt leaves room in both directions. A sized-up compression is not justified without a document.
findings.independence: Baseline tape (spot 5.23 as of 2026-11-25, 5d -0.95%). Yahoo shows the $5.50 close on 11-12 (search snippet).

findings.finding: The next guide is likely absent or cautious. Management withdrew quantitative guidance at Q2 and the bidder is the CEO's affiliate, so the outlook commentary is controlled by the buyer. A gloomy outlook (regulatory language already warns past profitability should not be assumed) supports the bidder's price and can widen the spread.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4'25 print with a weak Q1 guide fell 26.19%. The Q2'26 print that withdrew guidance rose 2.04%.
findings.why_not_priced: No-guide is already the market's base case since Q2. Only a harsher-than-expected tone would move it, and the deal anchor caps that.
findings.independence: The Q2 release's regulatory risk language (https://finviz.com/news/384651/x-financial-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results) and the Q4'25 release's 'operating losses cannot be excluded' (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/955039/x-financial-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-unaudited-financial-results).

findings.why_not_priced: Small: renewal is not expected by anyone tracking the bid. A surprise renewal would be mildly positive.
findings.independence: The dividend cadence is in the Q4'25 release (record 2026-04-30) and the Q2'26 release (record 2026-09-10).

Combined with lesson 8 (understatement), abs_move_pct was raised from 4.0 to 4.5. It stays well below 9 because the $6.03 bid anchors the price.

Lesson 'two readings of one document are one finding': the draft's separate regulatory-fee finding (-0.2) rests on the same Stockstar article as the volume-shrink finding. It was merged into that finding and moved to rejected_candidates as a duplicate, so impact_sum rose from +0.2 to +0.4.
